name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: UiElement
label: UI Element
description: Select the UI element (link, button, etc.) on the web page to click.

name: ClickType
label: Click Type
description: The kind of click to perform.

selectOptions.label: Double Click
selectOptions.description: Double-click with the left mouse button.

name: SendPhysicalClick
label: Send Physical Click
description: Physically move the mouse cursor over the element prior to clicking.

name: WaitForPageToLoad
label: Wait for Page to Load
description: Specify whether to wait for the new web page to load after the click.

name: TimeoutForWebpageToLoad
label: Timeout for Webpage to Load
description: Set the time in seconds for the page to load before the action throws an error.

name: IfAPopUpDialogAppears
label: If a Pop-Up Dialog Appears
description: Specify what to do if a pop-up dialog appears after clicking the link.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress
label: Dialog Button to Press
description: Enter the dialog button to press if a pop-up dialog appears.

name: MousePosition
label: Mouse Position Relative to Element
description: Specify where to position the mouse relative to the element before clicking.

name: OffsetX
label: Offset X
description: Move the mouse this many pixels to the right from the selected position.

name: OffsetY
label: Offset Y
description: Move the mouse this many pixels down from the selected position.
